description: List content approval batches for workspace_id. Use status=pending for pending work and page/limit for pagination (maximum 50). Summary status and content counts describe the current page; pagination.total describes all matching batches. Separate from aidelly_list_pending_approvals (post sign-off). Reading does not approve content.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_approvals
title: Get Approvals
